Align bands and categorical SCL masks, apply scale/offset metadata, exclude cloudy pixels, optionally form monthly pixel-median composites, and flag declines between adequately observed periods. Output parcel IDs join directly to ownership and weather tables. Synthetic offline assets ship in the wheel. Summarize prepared calibrated SAR intensity assets over polygon regions for time-series change analysis. Input region_id and geometry_wkb columns retain caller identity. Read local STAC ItemCollections or public STAC APIs, using vv/vh assets. This function accepts calibrated terrain-corrected linear power or decibel rasters, not raw radar, complex SLC, or an optical index. Convert dB pixels to linear power before spatial averaging, then report 10*log10(mean_power). Nonpositive linear power, nodata and nonfinite pixels are excluded. Pixel centres define membership. Keep platform, relative_orbit, orbit_state and polarization separate in temporal statistics. A viewing group's rasters must share CRS, resolution and pixel-grid alignment; differing extents are allowed. No resampling or additional speckle filter is performed. Missing observations are NULL, never zero. A change is not a damage probability. Coherence requires a separate phase-preserving SLC pipeline. Private asset signing is outside this function; use prepared local windows.
